Release review

HUMAN DECISION

A saved checklist of your team's evidence and unknowns. Statuses are user-reported, not automated verification.

Changing the release or build resets review statuses so old evidence cannot silently approve a new version. Previous reference notes are retained for you to revisit.

WHAT WE KNOW / WHAT WE DON'T

Review incomplete

A complete checklist does not establish release safety. Discuss coverage, unresolved risks and the deployment decision with the responsible people.

Your work, portable

BROWSER STORAGE

Export before changing browsers or clearing storage. This HIST workspace is separate from workbench stories. Exports contain your notes; remove credentials and personal data.
